greenhouse.recognize: Links or requests to boards.greenhouse.io/BOARD, job-boards.greenhouse.io/BOARD, or boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/BOARD.

board.description: Board name from the Greenhouse URL.

ashby.recognize: Links or requests to jobs.ashbyhq.com/BOARD or api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/BOARD.

board.description: Board name from the Ashby URL.

lever.recognize: Links or requests to jobs.lever.co/SITE or api.lever.co/v0/postings/SITE.

site.description: Site name from the Lever URL.

workday.recognize: Host ends in myworkdayjobs.com, with requests to /wday/cxs/TENANT/SITE/jobs.

search_text.description: Search text sent to Workday. Empty means all jobs.

eightfold.recognize: Requests to /api/pcsx/search, or a footer that says Powered by eightfold.ai.

url.description: Career search page URL. Its filters carry over to the API.

domain.description: Eightfold domain value, when it isn't the site's main domain.

icims_jibe.description: iCIMS Jibe career site API at SITE/api/jobs.
icims_jibe.recognize: The page requests SITE/api/jobs and the response has totalCount and jobs[].data.

jobs_path.description: Path that job pages live under.

oracle_hcm.description: Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Candidate Experience) search API.
oracle_hcm.recognize: Host ends in oraclecloud.com, with pages at /hcmUI/CandidateExperience/.../sites/SITE.

location_ids.description: Location filter IDs, one per allowed country. Detection looks them up.

radancy.description: Radancy (TalentBrew) career site search results API.
radancy.recognize: Career site with /search-jobs pages, and requests to SITE/search-jobs/results.

site.description: Site origin plus language path, before /search-jobs.

country_ids.description: Country filter IDs, one per allowed country. Detection looks them up.

adp_workforcenow.description: ADP Workforce Now public career center API.

cid.description: cid from the career center URL.

cc_id.description: ccId from the career center URL.

jazzhr.description: JazzHR job board, which lists every job on one page.

gem.description: Gem public job board API, which returns every job in one response.

browser_paginated.description: Loads numbered result pages in Chromium and collects job links until no new ones appear.
browser_paginated.recognize: Results are split into pages that change a URL parameter, such as page=2 or start=20.

page_param.description: URL parameter that selects the page.

first_page.description: Value of page_param on the first page. Default 1.

page_step.description: Amount page_param grows per page. Default 1.

link_pattern.description: Regex that only job posting links match.

total_regex.description: Regex with one group capturing the site's total result count from the first page's text. Without it, the company needs manual approval.

browser_page.description: Loads one page in Chromium and collects job links.
browser_page.recognize: All jobs are on one page, with no pagination or loading on scroll.

link_pattern.description: Regex that only job posting links match.

total_regex.description: Regex with one group capturing the site's total job count from the page text. Without it, the company needs manual approval.
